name: The First Awakening
description: Elder Kaito senses your potential. Prove yourself by mastering basic traversal and defeating corrupted shadows in Memory Alley.

objectives.description: Reach the Forgotten Rooftops using vertical traversal
Defeat 5 Corrupted Shadows in Memory Alley

dialogue.intro: Young one, I sense the Memory Weave stirs within you. Your three tails mark only the beginning. Prove your agility on the rooftops, and face the shadows that corrupt our streets.
dialogue.progress: The rooftops await. Trust in your instincts, and the shadows will fall before you.
dialogue.completion: Well done. Your movements carry the grace of legends past. The path ahead grows darker, but you are ready.
